evidence.note: Entra code for redirect URI not matching registration

evidence.actual: The redirect URI 'https://app.example.com/callback/' specified in the request does not match the redirect URIs configured for the application 'client-abc123'

evidence.note: Request URI has a trailing slash; the registered URI does not

output.fix: Make the redirect_uri in the authorization request exactly match a registered value, character for character. Either change the app to send https://app.example.com/callback without the trailing slash, or register the trailing-slash variant on the app registration if that is the URI you want. Use exact string matching and don't add wildcards or loosen the match. Send the same redirect_uri in the token request.

alternatives.why_not: The error is specifically AADSTS50011, which is a redirect URI mismatch, and not a general client configuration problem.
